growth_signal.value: Named among seven Australian startups that raised $274.7M in one week (Sept 2026).

raised.value: $14.5M Series B (currency not stated in source); earlier $6.75M plus a $2.5M grant

entry.idea: Dementia and mental health conditions have few good drug treatments, so Kinoxis develops new medicines for them.
entry.lesson: Turn university research into a company, and use grants plus venture money to pay for the long road to a drug.
entry.name: Kinoxis Therapeutics

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: A Series B followed an earlier smaller round, so funding is getting bigger.

market.reason: Brain disease drugs serve a huge worldwide patient group.

tech.reason: A university-born drug program looks real, but little detail is public so the edge is unproven.

sources.title: Seven Aussie startups that raised $274.7 million this week
Sydney Uni mental health biotech banks $14.5 million Series B

entry.twist: It is a University of Sydney spinout backed by a specialist Australian university venture fund.
entry.who_pays: Investors and research grants pay now; drug companies or health systems would pay if a medicine works.
entry.why_now: Ageing populations are making dementia a much bigger problem, and investors are putting money into brain medicines.
